title: 第25章 把她送进去不就行了第26章 熟女御姐夏灵
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
“这些办法之前都有律师跟我说过，我甚至询问了几个知名律师，他们说操作难度太大。”
说完，瞎哥也是嘆了一口气，表情略显失望。
他看向了林默：“如果林律师，你和你的助手只有这个水平的话，怕是救不了我。”
虽然瞎哥为人浮夸，但是在重大事情上，是很理智的。
夏灵所说的这些方法，他早就知道了。
“我...”
夏灵嘴角一抿，脸色涨的通红。
这种当眾被人否定的感觉太不好了，而且可能还会让自己丧失实习资格。
但这也没办法，这也是她能够想到最全面的方法了。
夏灵嘆了一口气：“你看吧，林律师，我就知道平常的办法不行，不如揍那女人一顿算了。”
林默嘴角抽搐了一下。
你特么简直是个小天才。
接著，林默就笑了。
夏灵这確实也是被逼急了，想了一堆办法没用，又繁琐，不如快刀斩乱麻。
武道中人跟你讲这些？
这时候瞎哥说道：“林律师，你笑什么，我这可是正事！如果你没有其他办法了，我马上就走。”
瞎哥脸说变就变。
来的时候，他也听说了一些林默的传言，说什么法律素养不行，只会整活的。
现在还多了一个妹子说要砍人。
这特么是要把活整上天啊！

“冷静。”林默笑著拍了拍瞎哥的肩膀，然后看了一眼夏灵。
“其实我的助理说的没错，这是所有专业律师都会使用的方式。”
“那就没办法了？”瞎哥皱著眉头反问。
“理论上来说，是的。”
“我....不信！”瞎哥咬牙切齿：“明明就是那个女人布的局，怎么就我吃亏！这还有王法吗！”
这时候，林默笑道：“別急啊，我还没说保准能行的办法呢。”
嗯？
瞎哥和夏灵都立马看向了林默。
保准能行的办法？
瞎哥立马露出了期待的表情。
夏灵则是好奇的看著林默。
在如今这个局面下还能有其他办法？！
林默看了一眼夏灵。
“正面从婚姻法论证，想要保存你的財產很难。”
林默停顿了一下，然后笑道：“那我们就换一个思路，直接起诉你老婆家暴，诈骗，以及非法转移財產吧。”
瞎哥：“嗯？？？？”
夏灵：？？？
夏灵甜美的脸上露出迷茫的表情。
这不是离婚官司吗？跟诈骗这些有什么关係？
这....这不合理吧？

瞎哥也是懵逼的说道：“林律师，起诉我老婆诈骗这...这合法吗？”
林默依旧带著笑意，没有直接回答，而是说到：
content_en:
"Lawyers have told me about these methods before. I even asked several well-known lawyers and they said they are too difficult to operate."
After saying that, Brother Blind also sighed, his expression slightly disappointed.
He looked at Lin Mo: "Lawyer Lin, if you and your assistant are only at this level, I'm afraid they won't be able to save me."
Although Brother Blind is exaggerated, he is very sensible when it comes to important matters.
He already knew the methods Xia Ling mentioned.
"I..."
Xia Ling pursed her lips and her face turned red.
This feeling of being rejected in public is too bad, and it may even disqualify yourself from internship.
But there was nothing she could do. This was the most comprehensive method she could think of.
Xia Ling sighed: "Look, Lawyer Lin, I know that the usual methods won't work, so I might as well beat that woman up."
Lin Mo's mouth twitched.
You are such a little genius.
Then, Lin Mo laughed.
Xia Ling was indeed driven into a hurry. She thought of a bunch of methods that were useless and cumbersome, so it was better to cut through the mess quickly.
People in martial arts tell you this?
At this time, Brother Blind said: "Lawyer Lin, why are you laughing? This is my business! If you have no other choice, I will leave immediately."
Blind brother's face changes at will.
When he came here, he also heard some rumors about Lin Mo, saying that he was not good at legal literacy and could only make ends meet.
Now there is another girl saying she wants to kill someone.
This is really going to bring the whole thing to heaven!
"Calm down." Lin Mo smiled and patted the blind brother on the shoulder, then glanced at Xia Ling.
"Actually, my assistant is right. This is the method used by all professional lawyers."
"Then there's nothing we can do?" Brother Blind asked with a frown.
"Theoretically, yes."
"I... don't believe it!" Blind Brother gritted his teeth: "It was obviously the woman who set up the trap, so why am I the only one who suffers! Is there such a thing as royal law?"
At this time, Lin Mo said with a smile: "Don't worry, I haven't said a sure way to do it yet."
Huh?
Both Blind Brother and Xia Ling immediately looked at Lin Mo.
A sure way to do it?
Blind Brother immediately showed an expectant expression.
Xia Ling looked at Lin Mo curiously.
Is there any other way to do this in this situation? !
Lin Mo glanced at Xia Ling.
"Based on the marriage law, it is very difficult to preserve your property."
Lin Mo paused, then smiled: "Then let's change our thinking and directly sue your wife for domestic violence, fraud, and illegal transfer of property."
Blind Brother: “Huh????”
Xia Ling:? ? ?
Xia Ling's sweet face showed a confused expression.
Isn't this a divorce lawsuit? What does this have to do with fraud?
This...isn't this unreasonable?
The blind brother was also confused and said: "Lawyer Lin, is it legal to sue my wife for fraud?"
Lin Mo still smiled and did not answer directly, but said:
